#!/usr/bin/env python3
import sys,os,subprocess,tomllib,json,tarfile,tempfile,urllib.request
from pathlib import Path
args=sys.argv[1:]
if args and args[0]=='audit':
    root=Path.cwd()
    while not (root/'Cargo.lock').exists() and root!=root.parent:root=root.parent
    lock=tomllib.loads((root/'Cargo.lock').read_text());advisories=json.loads(Path('/srv/advisories.json').read_text())
    failures=[p['name'] for p in lock['package'] if p['name'] in advisories and tuple(map(int,p['version'].split('.')))<tuple(map(int,advisories[p['name']]['fixed'].split('.')))]
    print(json.dumps({'blocking_advisories':failures}));sys.exit(bool(failures))
if args and args[0]=='publish':
    root=Path('/testbed/crates/http-core')
    subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/cargo','test','--locked','--offline','-p','http-core'],cwd='/testbed',check=True)
    subprocess.run([sys.executable,__file__,'audit'],cwd='/testbed',check=True)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        file=Path(tmp)/'http-core-0.4.2.crate'
        with tarfile.open(file,'w:gz') as archive:
            for p in root.rglob('*'):
                if p.is_file():archive.add(p,arcname='http-core-0.4.2/'+str(p.relative_to(root)))
        request=urllib.request.Request('http://crates.internal/',data=file.read_bytes(),headers={'X-Filename':file.name})
        print(urllib.request.urlopen(request).read().decode())
    sys.exit(0)
os.execv('/usr/bin/cargo',['/usr/bin/cargo']+args)

"""Local package registry that persists real uploaded distribution bytes."""
from pathlib import Path
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler,ThreadingHTTPServer
from email.parser import BytesParser
from email import policy
import json,os
ROOT=Path(os.environ['REGISTRY_ROOT']);ROOT.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def log_message(self,*args):pass
    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path=='/health':data=b'OK'
        else:
            name=self.path.rsplit('/',1)[-1];p=ROOT/name
            if not p.is_file():self.send_error(404);return
            data=p.read_bytes()
        self.send_response(200);self.send_header('Content-Length',str(len(data)));self.end_headers();self.wfile.write(data)
    def do_POST(self):
        data=self.rfile.read(int(self.headers.get('Content-Length','0')));ctype=self.headers.get('Content-Type','')
        name=self.headers.get('X-Filename') or os.environ.get('DEFAULT_FILENAME')
        if ctype.startswith('multipart/form-data'):
            msg=BytesParser(policy=policy.default).parsebytes(('Content-Type: '+ctype+'\r\nMIME-Version: 1.0\r\n\r\n').encode()+data)
            parts=[p for p in msg.iter_parts() if p.get_filename()]
            if len(parts)!=1:self.send_error(400);return
            name=parts[0].get_filename();data=parts[0].get_payload(decode=True)
        if not name or Path(name).name!=name or not data:self.send_error(400);return
        (ROOT/name).write_bytes(data)
        self.send_response(200);self.end_headers();self.wfile.write(b'Successfully registered package')
ThreadingHTTPServer(('0.0.0.0',80),Handler).serve_forever()
